description: stopPropagation in a capture-phase listener ends the dispatch at its invocation (DOM standard: one per node and phase), as Chromium does, where the framework declares no dispatch policy (React; listeners script adds for mousedown, which no React handler of the program listens for): the node's own bubbling listeners do not run, at the target its non-capture listeners (registered before the capture ones too) do not run, stopImmediatePropagation also skips the rest of the invocation, at the container, an ancestor and the target. A harness click and a script dispatchEvent of a MouseEvent take the same path
